hypothesis: Predecoded complete method CFGs with direct native branches and helper continuations can execute loops, Python/C calls and error paths through one existing VM Action consumer; this supplies the shared baseline/backend for optimizing method and trace frontends.
checkpoint_requirement: Concrete common descriptors/LIR, call-aware emitted method branches/helper calls and CodeUnit/Action ownership transitions available for review; not declarations only. Host encoder checks may emit actual instruction bytes. Report unfinished transfer/lifetime contracts explicitly.
completion_requirement: Complete native method CFG source for varying loop/branch/Python call/C bridge/normal and error paths, actual emitted entry and compiled-continuation witness producers, owner/invalidation/retirement and exact fallback, cheap checks and independent exact source review. Runtime exposure follows a separate bounded grant.
implementation_choices: Reuse existing PyMem allocation domain; BUILDING blocks recursive publication and recheck same exec/source/generation/epoch after cold allocation. Preserve/propagate pending errors from reentry; only error-free optional failure may decline.
Add narrow instrumentation detach before exec rewrites and post-helper observer/epoch checks. Resume after completed effects without replay.
Native resume enters a valid SysV prologue, establishes ctx/callee-saved registers, then selects logical word label once per transfer. Interior labels alone are not callable entry adapters.
One nullable exec-owned JitState and common CodeUnit owner; private sizeof/clear changes allowed and accounted. Code indices avoid hidden strong Python-object cycles.

Pin native bytes/metadata across C callbacks; detach entry before reentrant release. Handle terminal RETURN/ENTER before touching potentially freed old exec/frame state; clear borrowed pointers before unpin and resolve fresh caller on Python return.

Cold internal compile/install uses the same method compiler and normal admission. Forced compilation proves method execution, not automatic hotness. No per-function-name eligibility or revived arithmetic-prefix tier.
standalone_encoder_scope: Only actual encoder/LIR host fixtures; preserve original source/configuration/results. No candidate Python/JIT executable or full profile build.
next_gate: Freeze coherent source; independently review; then one finite native loop/call/error validation and emitted ABI/entry/continuation proof. Full29 and expensive qualification remain integration milestones.
